verses.text: Look, the LORD is emptying the earth and laying it waste. He’s flipping it upside down and scattering everyone who lives on it.
It’ll be the same for people and priests, servants and masters, maids and mistresses, buyers and sellers, creditors and debtors, and people who charge interest and people who pay it.
The earth will be emptied out completely, utterly wrecked. The LORD said it.
The earth grieves and fades. The world withers and fades. Even the most important people on earth are wasting away.
The people living on earth have polluted it. They crossed the line with its laws, ignored its rules, and broke the covenant that was supposed to last forever.
So the curse has eaten up the earth, and its people are guilty. The people of earth are burned up, and barely anyone is left.
The new wine mourns. The vine is dying. Everybody who used to have a good time is left sighing.
The tambourines go quiet, the cheering dies out, and the harp’s happy tune stops.
Nobody sings over their wine now. Strong drink tastes bitter to the people drinking it.
The city is a wreck. Every house is shut tight so nobody can get in.
People cry in the streets for wine. All their joy has gone dark. All the good times have drained out of the land.
The city is left deserted, and its gate is smashed to pieces.
That’s how it’ll be among the peoples of the earth, like an olive tree after it’s been shaken, like the few grapes left after harvest.
The ones left will raise their voices and shout about the LORD’s majesty. They’ll cry out from the sea.
So honor the LORD in the east! Honor the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, on the islands out at sea!

From the far edge of the earth we’ve heard singing: “Glory to the righteous one!” But I said, “I’m wasting away! I’m wasting away! I’m done for!” Traitors have betrayed people, and their betrayal runs deep.
Terror, the pit, and the trap are waiting for you who live on earth.
Whoever runs from the sound of terror will fall in the pit. Whoever climbs out of the pit will get caught in the trap. The windows up above are open, and the earth’s foundations are shaking.
The earth is smashed apart. The earth is split open. The earth shakes hard.
The earth will stagger like someone who’s drunk and swing back and forth like a hammock. Its rebellion will weigh it down so heavily that it’ll fall and never get back up.
That day the LORD will punish the army of the high ones up above and the kings of the earth down here.
They’ll be rounded up like prisoners in a pit and locked away. After many days, they’ll be dealt with.
Then the moon will be embarrassed and the sun put to shame, because the LORD of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem. His glory will shine before his elders.
